definitions.explanation: The point at which something begins. Noun form of the verb {始|はじ}まる (to begin). Can refer to the start of events, stories, relationships, or abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {物語|ものがたり}の{始|はじ}まりです。
examples.english: This is the beginning of the story.

examples.japanese: {始|はじ}まりがあれば{終|お}わりがある。
examples.english: Everything that has a beginning has an end.

examples.japanese: それが{二人|ふたり}の{友情|ゆうじょう}の{始|はじ}まりだった。
examples.english: That was the beginning of their friendship.

notes:
Noun form of the intransitive verb {始|はじ}まる (to begin). Compare with {始|はじ}め, which often means 'the beginning' as a point in time or 'at first.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{物語|ものがたり}の{始|はじ}まり (beginning of a story)
・{新|あたら}しい{始|はじ}まり (new beginning)
・{全|すべ}ての{始|はじ}まり (the beginning of everything)
・{始|はじ}まりから{終|お}わりまで (from start to finish)

RELATED WORDS:
・{始|はじ}め - beginning, first (often temporal: {初|はじ}めに = at first)
・{始|はじ}まる - to begin (intransitive verb)
・{始|はじ}める - to start (transitive verb)
